children: Telesat and an ad-hoc committee of GEO debt holders agreed that lenders will take no enforcement action through Jan. 18, 2027. Telesat will continue interest payments; term loans and certain secured notes mature Dec. 6, 2026.
The standstill delays enforcement, but does not resolve the upcoming debt maturities.
Term loans and some secured notes mature Dec. 6, 2026
The maturities fall before the standstill ends, leaving refinancing or a consensual resolution as key risks.
Interest payments remain due during the standstill, preserving a cash obligation.

This is a near-term debt-management development amid Telesat’s efforts to address upcoming GEO debt maturities. A refinancing or consensual resolution before the maturity date would be needed to reduce the risk beyond the temporary standstill.
